actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return ONE corrected complete portrait card. Image1 is the exact rejected full-resolution generated PNG editing target. Image2 is the unchanged original small card, sole authority for actual hair, expression, garment, pose, crop and lighting. Image3 supplies user mascot identity and compact rounded anatomy only.
Correct ONLY the sharp V-shaped yellow lower face directly above the dark tie. Finish ONE compact near-round mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin close beneath the mouth, resting immediately on a RAISED BROADENED existing white shirt collar. No elongated triangular jaw or yellow shaft: keep very short broad neck transition and minimal exposed throat. Raise and broaden source shirt collar coherently around rounded head base with actual front/rear cloth overlap and contact shadows. Keep source OPEN grey/green military lapels, real RED collar tabs with tiny pale/gold marks, white shirt and DARK GREEN necktie. Do not turn it into a plain suit or closed tunic. Preserve actual grey/green peaked cap with broad gold bands/central motif/dark visor, short grey temple hair and real grey eyebrow hair, clean understated face and serious closed downturned mascot mouth, green-ringed black eyes. Fine primary eye-rim/upper-lip detail is indistinct: no new prominent glasses, moustache or beard. Keep primary original head angle/roll/crop and light.
Do not copy human long neck/angular jaw into mascot anatomy. No pointed V funnel, pinched collar, separate yellow neck shaft, neck rolls, floating cloth, clipping or cream belly bib. Retain complete tilted dark frame, original OPAQUE photographic backing and lower-right cream note with faint indistinct marks and actual overlap. All skin, hair, solid dark cloth, shirt, collar, headwear, frame, backing and note remain fully opaque; genuine alpha only outside complete card silhouette. No invented decorations, readable text, labels, watermark, extra people or comparison sheet.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.

If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
